tasks.title: Implement exceptions and core models with construction-time validation
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/settings/exceptions.py with the SettingsError hierarchy: SettingsNotFoundError, SettingsValidationError, SettingsRegistrationError, TemplateNotFoundError, TemplateValidationError, TemplateStorageError
Create src/backend/settings/models.py with frozen Pydantic models: SettingKind, SettingStatus, SliderSpec, SelectOption, SelectSpec, SettingDefinition, SettingView, Template, SettingChanged
Enforce key format ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)*$ on SettingDefinition.key
Validate SliderSpec: min <= max, step > 0, and (max - min) is a non-negative multiple of step (max on the step grid)
Validate SelectSpec: options non-empty, option values unique and non-empty

Validate SettingDefinition per kind: default must be a valid value for its kind; SLIDER requires a valid SliderSpec and forbids select/pattern/length/value constraints; SELECT requires a valid SelectSpec and forbids slider/pattern/length/value constraints; TEXT-only constraints (pattern, min_length, max_length) rejected on other kinds; NUMBER-only constraints (min_value, max_value) rejected on other kinds; BOOLEAN/EMAIL forbid all kind parameters
Map any pydantic.ValidationError raised during construction to SettingsValidationError so the public error contract is the SettingsError hierarchy
Export the public API from src/backend/settings/__init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
design_constraints: All public models are frozen Pydantic models
Construction-time validation raises SettingsValidationError (never pydantic.ValidationError)
Key format, default validity, and kind-specific parameter presence/mismatch are enforced at construction
SliderSpec guarantees max lies on the step grid

tasks.title: Implement registry core: registration, per-kind validation, value access, resets, status
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/settings/registry.py with SettingsRegistry(event_bus=None, template_repository=None)
Implement register(definition): reject duplicate keys with SettingsRegistrationError; log registration at DEBUG
Implement register_feature(feature, definitions): reject any definition whose key does not start with f"{feature}." with SettingsRegistrationError

Implement per-kind value validation (TEXT pattern/length, NUMBER bounds with bool excluded, BOOLEAN, EMAIL via email-validator, SLIDER step grid within [min,max], SELECT option membership) raising SettingsValidationError
Implement get_value(key): return the current value, or the default if never set; unknown keys raise SettingsNotFoundError
Implement set_value(key, value): validate per kind, store and return on success, raise SettingsValidationError on failure
Implement reset(key) and reset_all(): restore the default(s); unknown keys raise SettingsNotFoundError
Implement get_status(key): MODIFIED iff the current value differs from the default, else DEFAULT; unknown keys raise SettingsNotFoundError
Implement get_definition(key) and has(key); unknown keys raise SettingsNotFoundError on get_definition
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
design_constraints: Values are validated per kind; bool is excluded from numeric kinds
get_value returns the default if never set
Unknown keys raise SettingsNotFoundError on every lookup
Duplicate registration raises SettingsRegistrationError
register_feature enforces the f"{feature}." key prefix

tasks.title: Implement template CRUD semantics (scope-coverage, leave-as-is load)
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
implementation_steps: Define the template scope for a (category, group) pair: settings s with s.category == category and (group is None or s.group == group)

Implement create_template(name, category, group, values=None): validate the name format; if values is None capture the current values of all in-scope settings, otherwise require values to exactly cover the scope with valid values; reject duplicate names; violations raise TemplateValidationError

Implement load_template(name): set each (key, value) in the template's values in key-sorted order via the normal set_value path; leave in-scope settings not in the template as-is; unknown names raise TemplateNotFoundError
Implement update_template(name, values): replace the stored values; values must exactly cover the scope; unknown names raise TemplateNotFoundError
Implement delete_template(name): remove the template; unknown names raise TemplateNotFoundError
Implement get_template(name), has_template(name), and list_templates() (name order); unknown names raise TemplateNotFoundError on get_template
Persist templates through the injected TemplateRepository (default to an in-memory repository when None)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
design_constraints: A template's values exactly cover its scope at creation and update time
Loads leave in-scope settings not in the template as-is
Template name format ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ is enforced
Unknown template names raise TemplateNotFoundError

tasks.title: Implement TemplateRepository and YamlTemplateRepository (atomic writes)
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/settings/repository.py with TemplateRepository ABC (save, get, delete, list)
Implement YamlTemplateRepository(directory): ensure the directory exists; one file per template named <name>.yaml; safe YAML
Write atomically: write to a temporary file in the same directory and rename over the target so a file is always absent or valid YAML
get(name): return None for a missing file; raise TemplateStorageError for corrupted or schema-invalid content (re-validate parsed content against the Template schema)
delete(name): idempotent (no error for a missing file)
list(): return stored templates in name order; raise TemplateStorageError for any corrupted file encountered
Provide an in-memory TemplateRepository implementation for the registry default and for storage-agnostic tests
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/settings/ tests/property/settings/ tests/unit/settings/ tests/contract/settings/ tests/integration/settings/ -v
design_constraints: TemplateRepository is the stable storage interface
A template file is always either absent or valid YAML (atomic writes)
get returns None for missing, raises TemplateStorageError for corrupted
delete is idempotent; list is in name order

tasks.title: Implement event-bus integration (SettingChanged) and observability
